scope.domain: N odd, d>=4, N>=6d-2, m=N-d, characteristic not dividing N, supplied primitive Nth root q, original unchanged coefficient space U and an explicitly represented list of 2N distinct coefficient-field scalars.
scope.stage: Deterministic selection of legal original-U coefficients, not complete physical bank construction. Two multiplicity-aware coprime pencils and a full original-axis test including reciprocal-gcd loci.
scope.accepted_arithmetic: O(N^4) scalar field arithmetic, O(N^3) inversions, O(N^2) storage
scope.scalar_interface: The fast-axis degree-2d minor makes the final guard degree 2N-1, requiring a supplied list of 2N distinct scalars. Field/list preparation is separately paid. Earlier H+1 scalar interface remains historical in its exact earlier proof.
scope.comparison: Replaces the exponential deterministic affine coefficient search through its independently accepted two-pencil and fast-axis refinements. The already available expected O(N^3) Las Vegas coefficient stage is NOT improved. Intermediate refinements are proof/accounting dependencies, not separately added discoveries.
scope.unchanged_costs: Genuine possibly huge splitting extension, root recovery, amplitudes/raw weights, physical outputs, validation and all bit/index/read/write/setup costs remain separate and paid. Finite quadratic coefficient-field preparation is not a splitting-degree bound. Literal warm application remains cubic in bank-count scale over the actual splitting field, before base-field expansion.
scope.support: The already published 5N/3+O(1) support bound is unchanged; this is not another bank-count improvement. No optimality, base-field attainment, efficient full compiler, FFT or end-to-end runtime improvement, historical novelty clearance or owner closure. All four parents stay TO RESEARCH priority56.
scope.range_composition: Separate exact-byte new-range fast-axis proof/review explicitly establishes compatibility with N>=6d-2; it is not inferred from the older domain.
scope.excluded: Optional coordinate/q-binomial note not included. The failed q-binomial seed fixture remains a rejection control, not a legal construction. Unmanifested caches and private coordination/release/native records are excluded.

projection.rule: Original manifests and binding hashes are historical original-byte inventories, not current hashes for projected files. PUBLIC_MANIFEST governs the exact published bytes. All theorem, addendum, review and operation-ledger bodies are byte-exact. Only explicitly listed documentary/fixture locators change; no scientific control logic or result is altered.
projection.execution_layout: Extract the outer archive, then extract dependencies/support/evidence.zip into dependencies/support. The outer archive root is the required cwd for projected fixture locators. Programs remain reviewed historical execution evidence, not promised turnkey public replays: axis_range_review/controls.py retains its original-author-hash binding tail, which rejects projected SOURCE_PINS bytes. The separate package verifier validates the explicit current-public mappings and runs no scientific program.
projection.nested_prior: The exact previously published support evidence ZIP and public manifest preserve all25 members and their previously disclosed projections. This is not a recursive export of every historical source archive.
